perusu-2025.title: Perusu
perusu-2025.synopsis: After discovering their father dead, two estranged brothers are shocked to find something inside him is still alive. What should have been a day of somber mourning breaks Into a complete bedlam as the two sons try to conduct the funeral as discreetly as possible. Forced to navigate nosy relatives, hidden family secrets, and their own strained relationship with their father, the brothers must hold it all together—or risk letting everything unravel.

badass-ravi-kumar-2025.title: Badass Ravi Kumar
badass-ravi-kumar-2025.synopsis: The Xpose franchise now goes to the next level  with Himesh Reshammiya doing a spin off from his iconic character Ravi Kumar. A rogue cop takes on a dangerous crime syndicate, using his own over-the-top methods to deliver justice in a high-octane, stylized action world.

love-u-muddu-2025.title: Love U Muddu
love-u-muddu-2025.synopsis: Love you Muddu is a Romantic drama film starring Siddu N, Rajesh Nataranga and reshmaa L.

kaalidhar-laapata-2025.title: Kaalidhar Laapata
kaalidhar-laapata-2025.synopsis: An ageing Kaalidhar escapes his family after overhearing their plans to abandon him. He meets the free-spirited Ballu, and they embark on an adventure to tick things off Kaalidhar's bucket list.

ibbani-tabbida-ileyali-2024.title: Ibbani Tabbida Ileyali
ibbani-tabbida-ileyali-2024.synopsis: What defines love? Memories that you can fondly look at? Tomorrow's dream of togetherness? Or the longing after separation?  Ibbani Tabbida Ileyali is a poetic tale of romance that intends to celebrate unconditional love. An attempt to capture the essence of yesterday's romance, the relevance of today's and the perpetual nature of it that can stand the test of the future!  We aspire to make you sing, smile, dance and savour the sweet melancholy. A story that spans a decade encapsulating the days of college, career aspirations and adulthood! Urban cityscape, the greens and more importantly the dreamy atmospherics. There's a scent of summer, the warmth of winter and the melody of monsoon!

suryapet-junction-2025.title: Suryapet Junction
suryapet-junction-2025.synopsis: A political action drama behind government freebies.

dhruvathaare-2024.title: Dhruvathaare
dhruvathaare-2024.synopsis: Parivartan, a heartbroken young man, struggles to heal from a painful breakup, while Apoorva tries to move forward from her past relationship. Their lives intersect on social media, sparking a beautiful romance. However, their newfound love soon faces an unexpected and formidable challenge.

kesari-2019.title: Kesari
kesari-2019.synopsis: تدور احداث الفيلم خلال عام 1897، يتتبع الفيلم اﻷحداث التي أدت بـ(هافيلدار إيشار سينج) للمشاركة في معركة ساراجارهي ضمن واحد وعشرين جنديًا من فوج السيخ الحادي عشر ضمن قوات الجيش البريطاني في مواجهة القبائل اﻷفغانية القاطنة في جبال أفريدي وأوراكازي، والبالغ عددهم عشرة اﻵف جندي.

dhakshina-2024.title: Dhakshina
dhakshina-2024.synopsis: Vizag city is horrified with brutal murders by a serial killer. A police officer arrests a crazy lady who is being spotted preceding at every murder scene. What is the shocking twist that the police officer knows from her investigation?

aalan-2024.title: Aalan
aalan-2024.synopsis: "Aalan" is a captivating tale that follows the life of a writer who discovers a deep connection to their past life, filled with tragic events and enduring love. As they delve into their memories, they unravel a story of heartache, resilience, and the power of love that transcends time. Through evocative storytelling, "Aalan" explores themes of fate, redemption, and the human spirit's capacity to overcome adversity. As the writer confronts their past, they are compelled to confront their present and embrace the possibility of a hopeful future.

the-smile-man-2024.title: The Smile Man
the-smile-man-2024.synopsis: A police officer who is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease must solve one last case before he loses all his memories. He must run against time to catch the notorious serial killer who he believes has a mysterious role in his own personal life.

snowman-2022.title: Snowman
snowman-2022.synopsis: تدور أحداث الفيلم حول المحقق (هاري هول) الذي يحقق في حادثة اختفاء امرأة، والتي عُثر على وشاحها الوردي ملفوف حول رجل ثلجي معروف بأنه نذير شؤم.

sab-moh-maaya-hai-2023.title: Sab Moh Maaya Hai
sab-moh-maaya-hai-2023.synopsis: The film is a poignant father- son story set in Ujjain. Inspired by true life, it deals with the sensitivity of unemployment, the selfless love of a father, and the behaviour of a selfish son, with quirk and humour.

virundhu-2024.title: Virundhu
virundhu-2024.synopsis: A fisherwoman takes on a powerful local politician by hosting a feast for him using an unforgettable secret dish that could save her dying lake.

anveshi-2023.title: Anveshi
anveshi-2023.synopsis: Anveshi , Starring VijayDharanDatla, SimranGupta, AnanyaNagalla in the lead Roles, Music  Composed by ChaitanBharadwaj, Background score by Simon S King, Written Andi Directed by V J  Khanna, Produced by T Ganapati Reddy Under the banner of Aruna sree entertainments.

bhaiyya-ji-2024.title: Bhaiyya Ji
bhaiyya-ji-2024.synopsis: After his younger brother is tragically killed over a petty argument, a feared and retired criminal Bhaiyya Ji, sets out to seek justice against the powerful Gujjar responsible, mobilizing his loyal comrades and igniting a wave of vengeance that threatens to shake the criminal underworld.

saapala-2024.title: Saapala
saapala-2024.synopsis: Uday Rohekar is a renowned playwright, but all his recent plays are flops. At this critical juncture in his career, Uday comes across a perfect script that can get him fame and fortune, if he could only get rid of the real writer.

once-upon-a-time-in-mumbai-dobaara-2013.title: Once Upon a Time in Mumbai Dobaara
once-upon-a-time-in-mumbai-dobaara-2013.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in Mumbai Dobaara
once-upon-a-time-in-mumbai-dobaara-2013.originalTitle: Once Upon a Time in Mumbai Dobaara 2013
once-upon-a-time-in-mumbai-dobaara-2013.synopsis: Shoaib's life takes a precarious turn when he finds himself pitted against a younger contemporary - not just in "business", but in love...

scary-movie-2026.title: Scary Movie
scary-movie-2026.synopsis: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

ramy-youssef-in-love-2026.title: Ramy Youssef: In Love
ramy-youssef-in-love-2026.synopsis: In his third HBO special, Ramy Youssef approaches a vast spectrum of personal topics, including marriage, AI, and being a dog parent.

i-spit-on-your-grave-deja-vu-2019.title: I Spit on Your Grave: Deja Vu
i-spit-on-your-grave-deja-vu-2019.titleEn: I Spit on Your Grave: Deja Vu
i-spit-on-your-grave-deja-vu-2019.originalTitle: I Spit on Your Grave: Deja Vu 2019
i-spit-on-your-grave-deja-vu-2019.synopsis: Following her rape, Jennifer Hills wrote a bestselling account of her ordeal and of the controversial trial in which she was accused of taking the law into her own hands and brutally killing her assailants. In the small town where the rape and revenge took place, the relatives of the rapists she killed are furious that the court declared her not guilty and resolve to take justice into their own hands.

tater-tot-patton-2017.title: Tater Tot & Patton
tater-tot-patton-2017.synopsis: A wayward millennial escapes to a South Dakota ranch, unhinging her Uncle's placid alcoholic life.

heldin-2025.title: Heldin
heldin-2025.synopsis: Dedicated nurse Floria navigates the relentless pace of her hospital’s understaffed surgical ward with humanity and warmth. As her overnight shift intensifies, she is pushed to the brink in a race against time.

i-m-still-here-2024.title: I’m Still Here
i-m-still-here-2024.synopsis: Between 1947 and 1967, Black-owned homes in Birmingham, Alabama, were bombed over 50 times. "I'm Still Here" is about three people who lived this history as children and elected to stay in Birmingham to try and turn the city's struggles with civil rights into a symbol for hope.

viaje-de-fin-de-curso-2025.title: Viaje de fin de curso
viaje-de-fin-de-curso-2025.synopsis: عام 2021. وبعد عزلة طويلة، ينطلق جمع من الطلاب في رحلة تخرّج طال انتظارها إلى جزيرة مايوركا. خطة مثالية تهدف لتعويض ما فات، والانطلاق في مغامرة لا تُنسى، تعجّ بالمرح والحرية. لكن تفش مفاجئ لفيروس كورونا يُربك حساباتهم ويحوّل أحلامهم إلى حجر صحي صارم داخل جدران الفندق. أكثر من 50 طالبًا داخل فندق واحد ومعهم معلّمان فقط، وعدد لا يحصى من الثلاجات الصغيرة الممتلئة بالمشروبات… فماذا عساه أن يحدث؟

cummings-farm-2009.title: Cummings Farm
cummings-farm-2009.synopsis: Three couples try group sex at a lakeside strawberry farm, naively hoping it will lead to enlightenment.

eflatun-2022.title: Eflatun
eflatun-2022.synopsis: Eflatun, a blind woman since childhood, has been able to get a hold of her life with the help  of her father’s various shadow and sound plays. Eflatun inherits her father’s profession of  clock repair. She waits for a man with who she had fallen in love with his voice. One day a  man whose voice is identical to the man she’s searching for comes into the shop.

tommy-boy-1995.title: Tommy Boy
tommy-boy-1995.synopsis: لإنقاذ أعمال العائلة، ينطلق اثنان من مندوبين السفر الفاشلين على الطريق، وتتوالى العواقب الكوميدية الكارثية.

simp-2024.title: Simp
simp-2024.synopsis: A model gets kidnapped at a fake photo shoot. Based on true events.

amar-2017.title: Amar
amar-2017.synopsis: يجرّب الشابان "كارلوس" و "لورا" عنفوان وهشاشة الحبّ الأول، بينما يقتل واقع الحياة اليومية أفكارهما المثالية عن الحبّ شيئًا فشيئًا.

gladiator-2000.title: Gladiator
gladiator-2000.synopsis: في روما القديمة، تتحول حياة الجنرال العظيم ماكسيموس إلى مأساة عندما يقتل الإمبراطور الجديد كومودوس عائلته ويرسله للعبودية. يجد ماكسيموس نفسه مجبراً على القتال كمصارع في حلبات الموت، متخذاً طريقاً دموياً نحو روما حيث يسعى للانتقام من الطاغية الذي دمر حياته.
gladiator-2000.tagline: ما نفعله في الحياة يتردد صداه في الأبدية

thor-2011.title: Thor
thor-2011.synopsis: تم طرد الإله القوي والمتغطرس ثور من أسغارد ليعيش بين البشر في ميدغارد (الأرض)، حيث سرعان ما أصبح أحد أفضل المدافعين عنهم.

sunset-after-dark-1996.title: Sunset After Dark
sunset-after-dark-1996.synopsis: A struggling screenwriter finds himself in the middle of a murder investigation.

christmas-in-lagos-2024.title: Christmas in Lagos
christmas-in-lagos-2024.synopsis: Romance is in the air when the beat drops for Lagos' Detty December. Fiyin is convinced her best friend Elo is the love of her life, but is shocked when he returns home for the holidays with a secret fiancée. Gbemi is torn between her boyfriend and an old flame, while London-raised Ivie seeks a wild holiday but doesn’t count on falling for Ajani.
